description: Create the evidence, monitoring, support, privacy, and governance trail required before claiming Power Platform completion.
external_blocker: Managed solution shell, custom connector, generated canvas app, and optimized canvas app were previously evidenced in NSW dylan. The 2026-05-24 authenticated browser sweep of the target NSW deployment environment found the documented MCHS app IDs, but no MCHS service-boundary connection, no MCHS custom connector match, and zero visible Power Automate flows. A 2026-05-25 optimized app launch attempt reached the Power Apps player route but redirected to Microsoft sign-in before app runtime. A later 2026-05-25 PAC CLI observation confirmed the target environment is active and the MCHS Service Boundary custom connector definition exists. The 2026-06-12 live PAC refresh confirmed the target environment, managed mchs_alm_orchestration solution version 0.2.2.0, and MCHS Service Boundary custom connector definition; it also confirmed that the current connection inventory still does not show the MCHS service-boundary custom connector connection. The 2026-06-12 GitHub secret audit confirmed repository secrets for the official Power Platform live gate are absent; only NUGET_API_KEY is configured. The live custom connector connection, connection-reference value, Power Automate flow run evidence, app runtime execution, target DLP connector policy, monitoring export, and GitHub live-gate secrets remain pending.
